_resolution: Resolved by cycle_date, never by today. A re-run of the March cycle in 2029 resolves March's register in March's order, including the entries that have since expired. The ordered set is hashed into overlay_stack_id and recorded on every assignment and every path row.

overlays.description: Tighten credit campaigns by one grade notch after August-cohort early-arrears deterioration
overlays.rationale: 30-day-past-due on the August cohort ran 1.8x model expectation on grades 6-7 across nine campaigns. Tightening while the model team investigates. Scenario 16.
overlays._break_note: Spec §5.3.4(b): an overlay starting inside an in-flight measurement window may only take effect at a boundary unless the break is jointly accepted and recorded. It was, on 2026-09-26, and any uplift reported across 2026-10-01 for campaign 23 must state it.

overlays.description: Volume dial - campaign 23 node L4-standard discretionary income floor R2 200 -> R2 600
overlays.rationale: Contact centre cut its committed volume; the forum asked campaign 23 to land at 350 000 rather than 412 000. Scenario 15.
overlays._withdrawal_note: Campaign 23 v12 folds this move into the published tree. The dial's target slot names node key n_a1f45e9c2b70d863, which v12 does not contain. Publication BLOCKED until this was withdrawn (validation/v12.report.json, overlay_disposition). It could not have reattached silently to the renamed node, because the node key is inside the slot id. Scenario 18.

overlays.description: -15 points behaviour score on the new-to-bank segment, all credit campaigns
overlays.rationale: Behaviour score is under-predicting on clients under 9 months' tenure.

overlays.description: Tier A ceiling R250 000 -> R200 000 for one cycle while funding is constrained
overlays._only_reduces: There is no field here that could raise an advertised amount above the pre-assessed amount. cap_reduction_pct has a validator of ge=0.0 and the step takes min() against the pre-assessment. Spec §5.5 req 6 is enforced by the absence of an expressible uplift, not by a policy.

overlays.description: Tighten campaign 52 by two notches, Q1 2026
overlays.rationale: Temporary, pending Home Loan book review.
overlays._scenario_17: Found still in force eleven months after the quarter it was approved for; its review date passed during a migration. The 2026-10 cycle FAILS with EXPIRED naming OV-2025-031, and refuses to run until it is renewed or withdrawn. Because the register is retained indefinitely and overlay_stack_id is on every row, the three questions - which cycles ran under it, how many clients it suppressed, and what would have been targeted without it - are all answerable from stored data: the third one directly, from the unadjusted_route_digest column.
